dodge.line: Barefoot girl sitting on the hood of a Dodge
stanza: And the Magic Rat drove his sleek machine
Barefoot girl sitting on the hood of a Dodge
Drinking warm beer in the soft summer rain
The Rat pulls into town, rolls up his pants
Together, they take a stab at romance and disappear down Flamingo Lane

lodge.line: And the mist from the eastern lodge
stanza: It was not the hunting that led me there
It was the ice in my hair
When the wind from the western mansion
And the mist from the eastern lodge
It was the night's long lying
